messages.content: Hi there! Thanks for taking the time to meet with me today. I’m really looking forward to learning more about the goals for modernising the mobile banking app. To start off, could you tell me what the high-level goals are for this project?

Hey! Thanks for having me. Honestly, I just want an app that feels as modern and fast as Revolut. I’m pretty tired of the old bank app, it just doesn’t keep up with what I need. It’d be great if I could know right away when money leaves my account and have the option to freeze my card instantly if I lose it. Those are the main things on my mind.

Thanks for sharing that! It sounds like you’re looking for a more modern and responsive experience, especially with features like real-time notifications and instant card freezing. Can you tell me a bit more about why those features are important to you?

Yeah, for sure! I mean, real-time notifications would just make me feel more in control of my money. You know, like knowing exactly when I spend something and how much is left in my account without having to check all the time. And the card freezing thing? It’s just so stressful when you think you’ve lost your card. I want to be able to handle that quickly, without having to call the bank and wait forever. Just feels way easier and safer that way.

I totally get that! Having control over your finances and feeling secure with your card are really important. So, just to clarify, you’re looking for real-time spending notifications and the ability to freeze your card instantly as key features to improve your experience with the app, right?
Yes, exactly! Those two features would really make a difference for me. I just want things to be quick and easy, like how it is with Revolut. It shouldn’t be complicated.
Got it! Quick and easy is definitely the way to go. Apart from those two features, are there any other specific functionalities or tools you think would enhance your experience with the banking app?

Hmm, well, I guess it would be nice to have something that gives me a breakdown of my spending each month. Like, just seeing where my money goes—like groceries or dining out—would help me a lot. And maybe setting some budgets for different categories too. It just feels like that would make managing my money so much easier. But I’m not sure what else I’d want right now.

That sounds really helpful! So, you're thinking about having a feature that provides a monthly breakdown of your spending and the ability to set budgets for different categories. That would definitely support better money management. Just to confirm, these budgeting tools and spending breakdowns are also important features for you, right?

Yeah, that’s right! Having those budgeting tools and a spending breakdown would definitely help me keep track of things better. It’s all about making it easier to see where my money is going and staying on top of my spending.

Thanks for clarifying that! It sounds like the budgeting tools and spending breakdown are key features for helping you manage your finances more easily. One last question: are there any limitations or restrictions we should be aware of while modernising the app? For example, compliance with regulations or any technical constraints?

Honestly, I haven’t really thought about that. I just want the app to work well and be user-friendly. I know there are rules and stuff, but I’m not really into the technical side of it. I just hope whatever you do makes it easier for customers like me.

I understand! You want the app to be user-friendly and effective, even if the technical side isn't your focus. So, just to sum up what we've discussed, here are some key features you've mentioned: 

1. Real-time spending notifications for better control over your finances.
2. Instant card freezing for quick action if your card is lost.
3. Monthly spending breakdowns to see where your money goes.
4. Budgeting tools for different spending categories to help manage finances.

If there's anything else, feel free to let me know. Otherwise, I think we’ve gathered some solid requirements!
